title: Chain-level affine perfect Hom presentation
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing} a diagram with colimiting cocone c, and i\in I. Let Y be affine [def-pc-scheme] with s:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the scheme derived categories, their restrictions to opens of Y, and the standard module-derived categories exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_Y) be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Put J=\{j\mid i\le j\} and o=i\in J. There exist a ring diagram F:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}, bounded finite-projective complexes E,K over F(o), a functor H:J_{\ge o}\to\mathrm{Type}, and a cocone d of H. There are equivalences ident_j:H(j)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(F(j))}(E\otimes F(j),K\otimes F(j)) and e:d.pt\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{colim}F)}(E\otimes\operatorname{colim}F,K\otimes\operatorname{colim}F). On every chain-map representative these equivalences identify H's transition maps and d's cocone legs with canonical scalar extension, using its associativity comparison. There are also equivalences stage_j:H(j)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_{Y_j})}(P_j,Q_j) and limit:d.pt\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_{Y_\infty})}(P_\infty,Q_\infty), where Y_j and Y_\infty are the specified pullbacks and P_j,Q_j their derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For every chain map f between the scalar extensions of E and K at j, put x=ident_j^{-1}(Q(f)). Then stage_k(H(j\to k)(x))=T_{j,k}(stage_j(x)) and limit(d_j(x))=T_{j,\infty}(stage_j(x)), with T the canonical transports [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. These two geometric equations are required only on chain-map representatives, not on arbitrary derived morphisms. No colimit property of d or descent assertion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Obtain F,E,K, their bounded finite-projective properties and the stage and limit module-to-geometric Hom equivalences, compatible with scalar extension on chain maps.
For these fixed complexes, construct H, its scalar-extension cocone d and module-derived Hom identifications ident and e.

Take geometric stage equivalence ident_j.trans(stage_j) and limit equivalence e.trans(limit). Retain the two module equations. Apply congrArg stage_k to the transition equation and compose with the geometric transition equation; Equiv.apply_symm_apply cancels ident_j and its inverse. Apply congrArg limit to the canonical-leg equation and compose with the geometric limit equation, cancelling ident_j again. These are the two required geometric equations.

theorem exists_affinePerfectChainHomPresentation
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q) :
    ∃ (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
      (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ),
      ((∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n) ∧
          Module.Projective (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n)) ∧
      ((∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (K.X n) ∧
          Module.Projective (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (K.X n)) ∧
      ∃ (H : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i) ⥤ Type (u + 1))
        (ident : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i), H.obj j ≃
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)))
        (d : Cocone H)
        (e : d.pt ≃
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)))
        (stage : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i), H.obj j ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj Q))
        (limit : d.pt ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k)
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          ident k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom
              (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
                (homOfLE j.property) (homOfLE hjk))) E K f)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i))
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          e (d.ι.app j ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (colimit.ι F j.val).hom
              (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE j.property)).symm)
              E K f)) ∧
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k)
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          stage k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.val.property hjk
              (stage j ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i))
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          limit (d.ι.app j ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            perfectLimitMap R c s j.val.property
              (stage j ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))))
